nodes.question: How were the search phrases constructed in the literature study?
nodes.answer: The search phrases were built as a combination of keywords associated with electronic healthcare devices (EHDs) and environmental assessment.
nodes.paragraph: The literature studies were sought from three research engines: PubMED, Scopus, and Embase. The search phrases were built as a combination of keywords associated with EHDs and environmental assessment. The search was divided into two categories of search phrases. 640 The International Journal of Life Cycle Assessment (2025) 30:638 653 In the first category, the search phrases were created as a combination of electronic healthcare device and keywords related to environmental assessment. In the second category, search phrases were built as a combination of digital health device and the same keywords from category one. This procedure is presented in Fig. 1. The temporal scope of the search was limited to articles published between 2013 and April 2023. Also, only English-language, peer-reviewed arti- cles were selected for screening. A total of 2696 studies were identified from the three search engines. 2.2 Screening criteria The yielded studies from the search engines were screened using a two-step process: title and abstract screening and full article screening. The former was performed to identify articles that fit the scope of the research, while studies that fell outside the healthcare sector S scope were excluded.
